name: User Password Changed
description: Sent when a user from any app or source that does not use pass-through authentication changes their IdentityNow password.
subject: Attention: Your ${PRODUCT_NAME} password update#if (${sourceFailedCount})#if (${sourceFailedCount} > 0) failed#{else} was successful#{end}#{else} was successful#{end}
body:
Password Change Notification

Dear ${user.name},

#if (${appCount}) #if (${appCount} > 0) #if (${appCount} > 1) #if (${appFailedCount} > 0)

Your password was changed for the following apps that share this password:

#{else}

Your password has been changed for the following apps that share this password:

#{end} #{else} #if (${appFailedCount} > 0)

Your password was changed for the following app:

#{else}

Your password has been changed for the following app:

#{end} #{end}
${appList}
#{end} #{else} #if (${sourceCount} == 0) #if (${sourceFailedCount} == 0)

Your password has been changed in ${PRODUCT_NAME}.

#{end} #{end} #if (${sourceCount} > 0) #if (${appFailedCount} == 0) #if (${appCount} == 0)

Your password has been changed in ${PRODUCT_NAME}.

#{end} #{end} #{end} #{end} #if (${appFailedCount} > 0) #if (${appFailedCount} > 1) #if (${sourceCount} > 0)

However, your password could not be updated for the following apps that also share this password:

#{else}

Your password could not be updated for the following apps that also share this password:

#{end} #{else} #if (${sourceCount} > 0)

However, your password could not be updated for the following app that also shares this password:

#{else}

Your password could not be updated for the following app that also shares this password:

#{end} #{end}
${appFailedList}
#{else} #if (${sourceFailedCount}) #if (${sourceFailedCount} > 0) #if (${appCount} > 0)

However, your password could not be updated for any of the systems that share this password.

#{else}

Your password could not be updated.

#{end} #{end} #{end} #{end} #if (${appFailedCount} > 0) #if (${appFailedCount} > 1)

Please try changing your password again on any of these apps. This change will apply to all apps in this email.

#{else}

Please try changing your password again on this app. This change will apply to all apps in this email.

#{end} #{else} #if (${sourceFailedCount}) #if (${sourceFailedCount} > 0)

Please try changing your password again. This change will apply to all systems and apps that share your password.

#{end} #{end} #{end}

If you did not make this change, please contact your IT administrator immediately.

Thank you,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
